sloka: ताम् तथा गर्हयित्वा तु मातरम् भरतः तदा ।रोषेण महता आविष्टः पुनर् एव अब्रवीद् वचः ॥२-७४-१॥
transliteration: tām tathā garhayitvā tu mātaram bharataḥ tadā ।roṣeṇa mahatā āviṣṭaḥ punar eva abravīd vacaḥ ॥2-74-1॥

translations.english: Overtaken by great wrath, Bharata reproached his mother and then said to her again:
